professionalSummary.text: Senior dispatcher and production support lead for the northern region elevator dispatch desk, responsible for maintaining live operation, incident response, vendor change management, runbook upkeep, and post-incident documentation.
professionalSummary.witness: Primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk in the northern region from 2021 to 2025, with the branch escalation route running through me during working hours and the duty phone outside them.

experienceHighlights.text: Managed the production support rota and branch escalation route for four years, ensuring continuous dispatch desk coverage.
experienceHighlights.witness: Primary holder of the production support rota for the elevator dispatch desk in the northern region from 2021 to 2025, with the branch escalation route running through me during working hours and the duty phone outside them.

experienceHighlights.text: First responder to all production incidents that halted dispatching, logging vendor outages with ticket numbers.
experienceHighlights.witness: First responder to every production incident that stopped dispatching in those four years; the three vendor outages of 2023 and 2024 are logged under my name in the regional incident log with the vendor's ticket numbers.

experienceHighlights.text: Implemented vendor scheduling releases into live system via quarterly change windows, maintaining separate acceptance and regression checks.
experienceHighlights.witness: Brought the vendor's scheduling releases into the live system through the quarterly change window, with the change log recording my acceptance checks separately from the vendor's regression checks.

experienceHighlights.text: Maintained dispatch runbook and response-time metrics for eleven branches, updating after each incident and release.
experienceHighlights.witness: Kept the dispatch runbook and the response-time figures for the eleven branches current for the service contract reviews, revising the runbook after each incident and each release.

experienceHighlights.text: Authored post-incident and hand-over notes detailing known limitations and hand-over conditions.
experienceHighlights.witness: Wrote the post-incident notes and the release hand-over notes, recording the known limitations of the technician availability feed and what the next rota holder needed to know.

projectsAndWorkSamples.text: Regional incident log extracts for three vendor outages, quarterly change logs, and current dispatch runbook.
projectsAndWorkSamples.witness: Work sample: regional incident log extracts for the three vendor outages with the vendor ticket numbers, the change log for the last four quarterly windows and the current dispatch runbook.
